//: Every external dependency, why we have it and which packages may use it (plan 7.1). Adding one needs Liam's approval. allowedIn takes package names; * matches any text.

@biomejs/biome.reason: Formatter and linter in one fast tool.

@stryker-mutator/core.reason: Mutation testing: finds tests whose assertions were hollowed out. Runs nightly in CI only, report-only at first (plan 9.3, D12).

@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner.reason: Lets Stryker run each package's Vitest tests (plan 9.3, D12).

@types/node.reason: Type definitions for Node, for Node packages, tests and tooling. The core's tsconfig loads no Node types.

@typescript/typescript6.reason: The TypeScript parser API for tooling/check until TypeScript 7.1 ships its own API (D9). Remove then.

turbo.reason: Per-package tasks, --affected and the build cache (D9).
